name: veterinary_clinic_system_060_geriatric_panel_recall
instruction: Run the monthly senior bloodwork recall for the practice. A canine or feline patient is due for a geriatric panel (CBC + serum chemistry) when they are at least 7 years old as of the episode date AND have not had a qualifying lab ('CBC' or 'Serum chemistry panel') resulted within the previous 365 days. For each due patient, push one reminder_queue row: {kind: 'senior_lab_recall', patient_id, owner_id, message: '<Name> (age <age in whole years>) is due for senior bloodwork — CBC + chemistry.', status: 'queued', queued_by: 'system', queued_at: episode timestamp, due_date: episode date, recall_batch: <batch_code>}. Push one communications summary to owner id '1': subject 'Senior recall batch <batch_code>', body '<N_canine> canine and <N_feline> feline patients were recalled for senior bloodwork (<N_excluded> excluded by recent lab).'. Push ops_reports rows for report='senior_lab_recall' and this batch: one per due species plus an 'ALL' rollup, each with {species, senior_count, recent_lab, due, recall_rate} computed from live data. Append one audit_log row: {actor: 'Dana Whitaker', actor_role: 'org_admin', action: 'SENIOR_RECALL_SWEEP', target_collection: 'reminder_queue', target_id: <batch_code>, details: 'Senior recall sweep <batch_code>: <N_due> due patients.', occurred_at: episode timestamp}. Do not process non-canine/feline patients, do not touch seeded reminder_queue rows, and make the whole sweep idempotent so a re-run reaches the same end-state.
_par_steps_note: placeholder -- measure via live gold run in QC session
_max_steps_note: placeholder -- set to roughly par_steps * 1.5 after live measurement

success_criteria.summary: Compute the set of due canine/feline patients from live patients and lab_results using the 7*365 age threshold and the 365-day lab recency window. Exactly one new senior_lab_recall reminder_queue row per due patient, keyed by (patient_id, recall_batch). Exactly one summary communications row to owner 1 with exact counts. ops_reports holds one senior_lab_recall row per due species plus an ALL rollup; every aggregate (senior_count, recent_lab, due, recall_rate) is recomputed via two independent paths (Python filter and SQL) and must agree with each other and with the written rows. One SENIOR_RECALL_SWEEP audit_log row. All non-canine/feline senior patients and seeded collections outside the blast radius remain untouched.

checks.expect: counts and row content match the live recomputation
due counts per species and total agree between Python filter and SQL

hazards: non-canine/feline seniors are a decoy set: the snapshot contains 25 non-canine/feline patients at least 7 years old (e.g., id 7 Ziggy avian, id 10 Willow equine, id 54 Penny exotic, id 31 Oliver avian, id 35 Loki equine); a species-blind age filter would over-recall these.

recent-senior-lab exclusion: 7 canine/feline patients are at least 7 years old but have a qualifying CBC or chemistry panel within 365 days of the episode date (e.g., id 53 Molly canine last Serum chemistry panel 2026-01-27, id 59 Molly feline last CBC 2026-05-17, id 232 Bailey feline last CBC/chemistry 2026-07-27); recalling them would over-notify.

episode-date boundary sensitivity: the due set must use (episode_date - dob).days >= 2555 and 0 <= (episode_date - resulted_at).days <= 365; the set is stable across the +/-3-day episode jitter, but an off-by-one boundary would silently change counts.

idempotency on re-run: the sweep's own reminder_queue rows are keyed by recall_batch and patient_id; a naive second run must not duplicate reminders, double-count the summary, or create duplicate audit/ops_reports rows.
multi-pet name collision: multiple due patients share common names (e.g., two 'Molly' entries), so matching reminders by patient_id, not by message text, is required.

domain_searches.query: AAHA senior wellness guidelines canine feline geriatric bloodwork CBC chemistry panel 7 years
top_results: AAFP Senior Care Guidelines for Cats (catvets.com)

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses a senior-wellness recall, a species-specific compliance report, and an audit trail into one mission; the due set is derived from a negative-evidence join against lab_results and must be stable across episode-date jitter and idempotent re-runs.
